testimonials_verbatim.text: Kristina was an absolute pleasure to work with from the lender side. She's proactive, responsive, and incredibly organized—always staying ahead of deadlines, communicating clearly, and advocating for the client every step of the way. She kept the transaction moving smoothly and made coordination between all parties easy. I'd happily partner with Kristina again and highly recommend her to any buyer or seller looking for a true professional.

Finding the right person is half the battle. Being a first time home buyer has enough stress in itself, yet alone finding the right person to be by your side along the way. My family and I were grateful for the opportunity to be recommended to Kristina. After a few short conversations with others, Kristina hit a little different. Polite, yet strong, realistic and dependable. I really can't put into words the happiness she brings. Kristina was willing to meet us within 24 hours of initial communication at the cutest coffee shop. She laid out all expectations, needs and we brought our desires. Kristina was quick to get us showings of the 6 homes we wanted to view, 3 being the first day we met. She read us, what we were after, asked questions, and gave some recommendations. The first weekend we were exhausted and emotions ran high being in our situation we had to move fast. We thought about a few things, talked it through with Kristina and had to give a home we viewed a second look. Knowing the market and knowing what was out there, time was not on our side. Kristina was willing to re meet us 45 minutes out of the way, at night for us to check a few last small things. She didn't hesitate, took our questions and got us answers quickly. At this point Kristina was quickly becoming part of the family. We were pretty firm that this was going to be it but us being as thorough as possible needed to check one last thing before we moved forward. Kristina again didn't hesitate. She met us the next day, during lunch hour 45 minutes out of the way to be there for us. I can't count the times that we were beyond grateful for how much Kristina went above and beyond for us. We secured a plan, and she made sure it was submitted that next morning. Between the calls, texts, meetings, Kristina always made sure we were informed, happy, and excited. Kristina had the best attitude through it all. We had our deal in and within days she personally called to let us know the deal was accepted. Now the fun began. Organizing all the next steps, again being super informative, we had our documents signed, inspection set up. With our schedule getting to everything wasn't always doable. She made sure to take all our questions and get us our answers. She let us vent and she negotiated her heart out. She knew health and safety were our biggest worries coming from our situation so she knew there was no give in some areas. Kristina was able to secure us many things that we honestly were holding our breath on, and Christmas Day received the acceptance to move forward on some needed repairs. We then were hit with a unexpected low appraisal. Something that isn't heard of too often. Again though, she communicated with us, she explained the expectation and we expressed our concerns. Kristina was on the block again with negotiations, and without fail, conquered the task. We secured our home, our first family home, 2 kids in tow, with the many negotiations, many meet ups, many phone calls and text messages back and fourth to the finish line. To top it off, she was even willing to meet us at signing! Kristina went from stranger to family friend and I couldn't be more happy to of met her. If you are looking for someone truthful and honest, friendly but strong, and pull out all the stops, she is the one.
